segments.name: Income Properties
segments.description: Owns and operates shopping centers and single-tenant retail properties generating rental income.
segments.evidence: Revenue and operating income from our income property operations totaled $132.2 million and $94.2 million, respectively, during the year ended December 31, 2025.

segments.name: Management Services
segments.description: Provides management services to external clients including portfolio and asset management.
segments.evidence: Revenue from our management services totaled $4.8 million during the year ended December 31, 2025, of which $4.4 million was earned from PINE, $0.3 million was earned from the Portfolio Management Agreement, and less than $0.1 million was earned from the Subsurface Management Agreement.

segments.name: Commercial Loans and Investments
segments.description: Provides interest income through commercial loans and structured investments in real estate.
segments.evidence: Interest income from our commercial loans and investments totaled $12.5 million and $7.4 million during the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.

revenueModel.text: Tenants pay rent on leased retail properties; clients pay management fees; borrowers pay interest on commercial loans.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue from our management services totaled $4.8 million during the year ended December 31, 2025, of which $4.4 million was earned from PINE, $0.3 million was earned from the Portfolio Management Agreement, and less than $0.1 million was earned from the Subsurface Management Agreement.

changes.text: In 2024, the Real Estate Operations segment was discontinued after the company completed sales of all remaining Subsurface Interests and mitigation credits.
changes.evidence: There was no revenue or operating income from real estate operations during the year ended December 31, 2025, because the Company sold its portfolio of Subsurface Interests and all remaining mitigation credits during the year ended December 31, 2024.
